questions.question: A service that lets you provision a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where you can launch AWS resources in a virtual network that you define, with full control over routing and security.
A global content delivery network service that securely delivers data, videos, and applications to users worldwide with low latency using a network of edge locations.
A service that automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets — such as EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses — in one or more Availability Zones.
A fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scale.
A highly available and scalable DNS web service that also provides domain registration and traffic routing policies such as latency-based, geolocation, and failover routing.
A service that provides a dedicated private network connection from your data center to AWS, bypassing the public internet to reduce latency and increase bandwidth consistency.
A networking service that improves global application availability and performance by routing traffic through the AWS global network to optimal endpoints rather than the public internet.
A hub-and-spoke networking service that allows you to connect thousands of VPCs and on-premises networks through a single gateway, simplifying your network topology at scale.
A technology that provides private connectivity between VPCs and AWS services, or your own services, without exposing traffic to the public internet or requiring VPC peering or gateways.
A service mesh that provides application-level networking for microservices, giving you visibility and control over communications between your services regardless of how they are implemented.
